blocks.title: Latte art is our little treat.
blocks.text: Beans roasted in Paris by Terres de Café, a bright red Conti machine, and time to do it properly. Espresso, flat white, V60 filter. And a heart drawn in the milk.

blocks.title: One bowl of ash and the day looks better.
blocks.text: Herb and noodle ash reshteh, weekend haleem, adasi, bandari sandwich. House recipes, served the way they are back home. New to it? We'll walk you through.

blocks.title: In the heart of little Tehran.
blocks.text: Persian grocers, pastry shops, restaurants: rue des Entrepreneurs has an Iranian accent. Shekamou moved in in February 2025, one minute from Charles Michels metro.

items.a: No, we don't take bookings: drop in whenever you like, 7 days a week. For a group or platters, send us a request from the Platters page.

items.q: Are there vegetarian or vegan options?
items.a: Yes. Ash reshteh is fully vegetarian, as are the grilled aubergine sandwich, the egg toasts, the smoothies and most of the sweets. For something free of animal products, ask at the counter: we'll tell you what's possible that day.
Yes, every coffee, latte, matcha and ube latte can be made with plant milk. Just mention it when you order.

items.q: Can I order to take away?
items.a: Yes: build your order from the menu, pick a collection time and pay at the counter when you arrive. You can also call +33 9 56 70 91 12. Shekamou is on Deliveroo too.

items.q: Can I work from the café?
items.a: On weekdays, gladly: free Wi-Fi and laptops welcome. At weekend brunch time the room is busy and the rules may differ, so ask at the counter.
On Saturdays and Sundays, made fresh for the weekend. Ash reshteh and adasi depend on the day: give us a call if you're coming especially.
You pay at the counter, whether you eat in or collect an order. For platters, the café explains payment along with its proposal.

iranien.intro: In Persian, shekamou (شکمو) means someone who loves to eat. Specialty coffee in the morning, Tehran dishes at lunch, and always a little saffron.

sections.h: A Parisian café, an Iranian kitchen
p: Shekamou opened in February 2025 at 42 rue des Entrepreneurs. At the counter, a proper coffee shop: espresso, flat white, latte art, ube latte. In the kitchen, the dishes people eat in Iran, made on site.
You'll hear Persian, French and English. And everyone ends up ordering a bowl of ash.
Around rue des Entrepreneurs, Persian grocers, pastry shops and Iranian restaurants have lined the streets for years. Shekamou is its coffee shop: a coffee before the shopping, a bowl of ash after.
Charles Michels metro (line 10) is one minute away, Commerce (line 8) seven.
The sweets keep the accent: saffron cake with rose petals, pistachio cake, pomegranate juice. With a glass of tea, or a latte.

paris15.metaDescription: Shekamou, a coffee shop in the 15th arrondissement: Terres de Café beans, latte art, ube latte, matcha, brunch and focaccias. Free Wi-Fi, open daily from 8 am. Charles Michels metro.
paris15.intro: Specialty coffee, colourful drinks and brunch, one minute from Charles Michels metro. Open every day from 8 am.

sections.h: Specialty coffee on rue des Entrepreneurs
p: The beans come from Terres de Café, a Paris roaster, and go through a Conti machine. Espresso at €3, flat white, cappuccino, V60 filter, and decaf for the afternoon.
Latte art comes with it: heart, tulip or rosetta, depending on the barista's mood.

Morning: croissant and coffee. Lunch: a sandwich on home-made focaccia, pastrami, crispy chicken or grilled aubergine. For brunch, English breakfast and egg plates. Afternoon: ube latte, mango matcha or a smoothie, with a slice of saffron cake.
Free Wi-Fi, laptops welcome on weekdays. In a hurry? Order online and pick up at the time you chose.
